versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Data Analysis Standard skill.
- Provides structured frameworks for metric deep-dives, funnel, and cohort analysis.
- Includes ready-to-use templates and checklists for root cause investigation, confidence assessment, and recommended actions.
- Emphasizes clear communication: each analysis must answer what changed, why, so what, and now what.
- Offers stakeholder-ready output formats and guidance for actionable product decisions.
